events.title: 2nd Annual Legacy Gala
events.location: County Club of York, 1400 Country Club Rd, York, PA, 17403
events.description:
Join Crispus Attucks York for our 2nd Annual Legacy Gala on Thursday, October 22, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM at the Country Club of York, as we proudly honor Rebecca and Frank Countess for their extraordinary commitment to our organization and the York community. 
Together, the Countess family has made community service a way of life. Their commitment to Crispus Attucks York spans multiple generations. The Legacy Gala will be an evening of celebration, fellowship, fine dining, and reflection as we honor Rebecca and Frank’s lasting impact while highlighting Crispus Attucks York’s 95-year legacy of empowering youth, strengthening families, and creating opportunities throughout our community. 
Theme: Molded by History. Changing Our Future. 
For sponsorship opportunities, please contact Donna Williams at 717-848-3612 or dwilliams@crispusattucks.org.
